description: This file provides a localized German translation for the Select2 plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines messages used in the UI such as error loading, input length constraints, loading more results, maximum selections, no results found, and searching indicators.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message indicating how many characters need to be removed if input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message indicating how many characters to add if input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message shown while searching.
